$comment: Plain-language definitions appended to every report (build_report.py) for the terms it uses. `match` = case-insensitive word stems unless `case` is true.

terms.text: Clicks from Google Search results to the site (Search Console).
Times a link to the site was shown in Google results (Search Console).

The CTR this site usually gets at a given position, from its own non-brand Search Console data (this period, else its last 12 months); where it has too little data, a 2025+ industry study measured after Google's AI Overviews, labelled heuristic.
Average ranking in Google results, weighted by impressions; 1 is the top result, so lower is better.
Rare searches Google hides for privacy: counted in site totals, missing from query-level rows.
A visit that lasted 10+ seconds, viewed 2+ pages or completed a key event (GA4).
An action marked as important in GA4, such as a form submission (formerly called a conversion).
Too few impressions to call a change a trend (below the min_impressions threshold).
Queries ranking just below the top results, where a small gain reaches page one.

Core = chosen by the team; Brand = brand names; Proven = service searches with the most clicks; Opportunity = service searches with many impressions just below the top results; Generic = top non-service searches. Proven, Opportunity and Generic are picked automatically by the site rules.
The page that should rank for a tracked keyword; 'wrong page' means Google shows another page more often.
